Date: How the Nap-Adjusted Score works (my estimate, not Garmin's)
• Start with the Garmin sleep score.
• Add a nap bonus: up to +12 points, scaled by nap length (90 min or more = full +12).
• Take off 3 points if the nap started at or after 5 PM (late naps can hurt night sleep).
• If Total Sleep is under 6 hours, the score is capped at 79 (FAIR).
• Labels: 90+ Excellent, 80–89 Good, 60–79 Fair, under 60 Poor.

• No missing nights remain: Garmin sleep data for the nights waking Mon Oct 12 and Sat Oct 17, 2026 was added Oct 19, so every night from Aug 9 to Oct 19 is filled in (none estimated). Fitnesstracker maintains the Sleep and Naps tabs.
• Bedtime (PT) and Wake Time (PT) come from Garmin and are left blank when Garmin has no data.
